text: APPROVE. Moving the loop and its branching into `Evaluate` removes most of the nesting-weighted complexity from `Read`, and the logic in `Evaluate` is unchanged. `Read` still returns on the first readable file, `Unknown` is still returned when `known == 0`, and the `Strictness` arguments are the same. The new private static helper uses all its parameters and the types line up, so I see nothing that would produce a warning-as-error. This is judged from the diff alone; I did not build it or measure the complexity.
